hero.headline: Warehouse inventory software for multi-location teams
hero.subCopy: Track stock balances across warehouses, process inbound and outbound vouchers with maker-checker approval, and keep audit ledgers accurate.

preview.title: See how each warehouse role operates
preview.subtitle: Switch between Admin, Manager, Staff, and Viewer below to inspect how menus, permissions, and stock voucher approvals adapt automatically.
preview.ledgerSub: Live maker-checker workflow preview across assigned facilities

features.title: Built for daily warehouse operations
features.subtitle: Every core inventory module connected under unified audit logs and warehouse rules.
features.f1Desc: Draft, submit, and approve receipts and dispatches while blocking self-approval and negative-stock issuance.
features.f2Desc: Switch seamlessly between individual facilities or consolidated all-warehouse stock summaries.
features.f3Desc: Organize products, categories, units of measure, and approved vendor records in one searchable index.
features.f4Desc: Detect SKUs approaching minimum reorder points before stockouts stall fulfillment operations.
features.f5Desc: Count physical bin quantities, calculate variances against system ledger totals, and finalize reconciliations.
features.f6Desc: Review balance sheets, stock movement history, and export UTF-8 spreadsheet reports cleanly.

benefits.title: Eliminate spreadsheet drift across teams
benefits.subtitle: Replace ad-hoc manual tracking files with deterministic workflows shared across warehouse operators and supervisors.
benefits.b1: Prevent accidental self-approval with built-in Maker-Checker rules on vouchers
benefits.b2: Validate outbound quantities against real available stock to block negative balances
benefits.b3: Scope supervisors and staff strictly to their assigned warehouse facilities
benefits.b4: Keep procurement, stocktaking, and alerts aligned under one SKU catalog
benefits.b5: Choose your preferred interface language without leaving the workspace

roles.title: Clear boundaries for every team member
roles.subtitle: Structured roles isolate administrative configuration, manager approvals, warehouse floor intake, and read-only auditing.

cta.title: Ready to explore the warehouse workspace?
cta.subtitle: Create a local demo account or sign in immediately with one of four preconfigured test roles.
cta.subtitleProd: Create your company account or sign in to start managing multi-warehouse operations.
